## Requirements (contract)

1. **Reproducible stratified audit** — a recorded sampling frame over source family, capture epoch
   (before/after persistent capture storage), predicate role and compartment, with reproducible
   seed, input digest, spine watermark and denominators reconciling to the selected population.
2. **Capture availability + claim→evidence lineage reported independently** — byte-level verification
   (digest check at the pinned OCFL version) is one axis; acquisition-occurrence attestation
   (`evidence_capture` + `ingest_run_capture` marks) is another; locatability (typed locator) is a
   third. Five evidence states: `exact_replayable` / `document_locatable` /
   `source_attributed_only` / `unrecoverable` / `restricted_not_public` — plus separate exact/
   bounded/unknown occurrence confidence. Never derived solely from `source_id`.
3. **Bounded replay/repair plans** — append-only disposition/repair proposals with provenance,
   row/disk/time estimates citing actual ceilings, deterministic plan digests, restart without
   duplicate dispositions, and **zero writes for ambiguous lineage**; unrecoverable stays
   unrecoverable (never reconstructed by pretending a new fetch is the old capture).
4. **Semantic reporting in three separate forms** — support over ALL sampled eligible claims
   (unresolved counted not-established), conditional adjudicated fidelity, and adjudication yield;
   missing/ambiguous evidence cannot inflate fidelity by disappearing.
5. **Dry fixtures + live return-pass packet** — recoverable / digest-mismatched / missing /
   restricted byte fixtures; a committed packet with pinned commands for the later live pass —
   never a re-fetch of historical evidence.

## Plan → landed

(landed — all rows below are in the working tree; verification in the log)

- **`db/src/db/evidence_audit.py`** — the read-only audit row loader
  (`evidence-audit-rows/1`): one chunked SELECT over claim → claim_evidence → evidence_capture →
  evidence_artifact → ingest_run, plus `ingest_run_capture` marks by digest, `spine_watermark`,
  and claim eligibility via the shared `db.dispositions.claim_eligible_sql` fragment (reuse, never
  a second definition). Emits plain dict rows — no writes, ever.
- **`ops/src/ops/evidence_audit.py`** — the pure audit core (`evidence-audit/1`): the state
  taxonomy, `CaptureProbe` protocol (OCFL-backed + fixture + null probes), per-capture byte
  verification (pinned `ocfl_version` resolve + `multihash` recompute — the connectors' own
  digest function, `connectors.capture_ocfl.multihash`), per-claim classification, stratification,
  deterministic seeded sampling (sha256 of `seed|claim_id`), the metrics table with per-stratum
  and weighted values, the semantic-support trio, and the reproducible `AuditReport`.
- **`ops/src/ops/recovery_plan.py`** — the planner (`recovery-plan/1`): action proposals
  (bind-verified / repair-claim / record-disposition / disclosure), per-batch bounds
  (≤10 000 assertions or ≤250 MiB distinct bytes), row/disk/time estimates citing ADR-107/111/114
  ceilings + the S1 pilot/recovery bounds, deterministic action+plan digests, restart-aware
  `already_planned`/`+0` semantics, zero-write ambiguity rules, and the live return-pass packet
  writer.
- **CLI** — `sig-ops evidence-audit` (read-only `--dsn` or `--input-json`, `--capture-dir`
  OCFL root, recorded `--seed`/`--sample`/`--roll-boundary`) and `sig-ops recovery-plan`
  (reads an `audit_report.json`, `--applied` digest file for restart simulation) — additive verbs.
- **Committed dry-run evidence** — `docs/build/reports/p32.6-legacy-evidence/`:
  `fixture_spine.json` (the four fixture classes + targeted cases), generated `audit_report.json` +
  `AUDIT_REPORT.md` + `recovery_plan.json` + `LIVE_RETURN_PASS.md` + `packet.json`.
- **ADR-125** + Appendix F row (spec_src edit + BUILD.sh regen, never a direct spec edit).
- **`D-R10-LIVE-1`** annotated in place (OPEN; proxy landed).

## Test matrix (Phase 1 — every row must fail if the behaviour is removed)

| # | Acceptance anchor | Test (tests/ops, tests/db) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | denominators reconcile to population | census totals == unit count per stratum axis; `reconciles` true |
| 2 | reproducible frame | same input+seed → byte-identical report; different seed → different sample ids |
| 3 | no source_id-only replayability | claim with real source_id + synthetic capture ⇒ never `exact_replayable`; replay numerator ⊆ verified-byte units |
| 4 | recoverable fixture | real bytes at pinned version + marks + locator + extractor ⇒ `exact_replayable` + `exact` occurrence |
| 5 | digest-mismatched fixture | probe bytes ≠ recorded digest ⇒ `digest_mismatch` finding + unrecoverable; never adopted |
| 6 | missing fixture | mark/capture recorded, OCFL object absent ⇒ `missing_object`; unrecoverable, reported explicitly |
| 7 | restricted fixture | verified bytes + `restricted`/`sealed` tier ⇒ `restricted_not_public` — distinct from missing |
| 8 | lineage independence | verified bytes + no mark ⇒ grade replayable but occurrence `unknown` (axes independent) |
| 9 | locator axis | verified bytes + bad/absent locator ⇒ `document_locatable` not `exact_replayable` |
|10 | extractor pinning | verified bytes + locator, no extractor identity ⇒ `document_locatable` + flag |
|11 | ambiguity | two candidate captures for one claim ⇒ `ambiguous_lineage`, occurrence `unknown` |
|12 | pre/post-roll epoch | captures dated across boundary ⇒ claims land in the right `capture_epoch` stratum |
|13 | unsupported role | operational-role predicate + synthetic-only support ⇒ `unsupported_role_mapping` flag + unresolved |
|14 | provenance role guard | publisher predicate never mints operator support (uses `mints_entity_ref`) |
|15 | semantic trio | unresolved in `support_all` denominator, out of `conditional_fidelity`, yield reported |
|16 | missing cannot inflate | removing a unit's bytes lowers `support_all` + `adjudication_yield`, never raises fidelity |
|17 | zero-write ambiguity | planner emits `proposed_writes: []` + `deferred_ambiguous` for ambiguous units |
|18 | unrecoverable preserved | planner emits no write for unrecoverable; status `unrecoverable` recorded |
|19 | digest-mismatch zero-write | mismatch ⇒ no write proposal (never adopt new bytes as old) |
|20 | restricted | restricted bytes ⇒ privileged verification path noted; no public action proposed |
|21 | restart +0 | plan twice + feed applied digests ⇒ `already_applied`, no duplicate disposition digests |
|22 | bounded batches | >10k-action or >250 MiB input ⇒ >1 batch; `exceeds_ceiling` flagged per rules |
|23 | estimates cite ceilings | plan records batch/row/disk/time estimates + the named ceilings (pilot, recovery, headroom) |
|24 | append-only proposals | every action maps to INSERT-only tables (claim, claim_evidence, publication_disposition) |
|25 | live packet | packet pins input digest, commands, ceilings, checklist; states no-fetch/no-mutation rules |
|26 | eligibility reuse | audit consumes `claim_eligible_sql` outputs; fixture units carry `publication_eligible` |
|27 | DB loader | (docker) loader emits the documented row shape; read-only (no writes to spine) |
|28 | CLI | `evidence-audit --input-json` and `recovery-plan` produce the committed packet shape |
